# Closet

> A household's wardrobe on its own server: photographed garments, the outfits made from them, a calendar of what to wear, and a wardrobe one person can share with another.

## In short

Closet is MIT-licensed, self-hosted software. It is a progressive web app rendered on the server and meant to be installed on a phone; everything it stores lives in its own PostgreSQL database and data directory.

## Pages

- / - Today, the home screen
- /wardrobe - the garments
- /outfits - saved outfits and the outfit builder
- /calendar - the planned week and month
- /about - what Closet is and its licence
- /auth/login - sign in (every page needs it)

## Built with

- TypeScript on Fastify 5, pages rendered as JSX on the server (hono/jsx), no client framework
- htmx for interaction; Tailwind CSS and daisyUI for styling
- PostgreSQL through Drizzle ORM
- Background removal on the server (BiRefNet under ONNX Runtime, in a child process): no photo is processed in the browser
- A Workbox service worker for offline reads; Web Push for notifications
- Photo files on local disk

## Where to find it

- Source: https://github.com/kashhq/closet
- Image: ghcr.io/kashhq/closet
